as_told.title: Lead Bell scientists Grawitz and Gerlach, per Witkowski

plain: According to Michels, a secret Nazi wartime project of the 1940s known as the Bell had an SS medical chief named Ernst Grawitz on its staff, and Grawitz was its lead scientist. The SS was the Nazi party's own armed and police force. Michels says this was documented by a Polish journalist named Igor Witkowski, and he tells it twice in 2025, in episodes with the writers Richard Dolan and Jason Jorjani. The second time he adds that Grawitz worked directly under the Nazi doctor Josef Mengele. If true, it would put a senior Nazi medical officer at the head of the project.
